+/// Extract positioned text, restoring logical order for producers that wrote
+/// RTL text visually.
+///
+/// The verdict needs every page, but the correction must be applied to unmerged
+/// runs — before a document-wide view exists. So the first pass only gathers
+/// evidence, and the rare visual-order document is extracted once more with the
+/// verdict known.
 fn extract_positioned_text_impl(
     doc: &Document,
     font_cmaps: &FontCMaps,
     page_filter: Option<&HashSet<u32>>,
     include_invisible: bool,
     required_pages: Option<&HashSet<u32>>,
 ) -> Result<(PageExtraction, PageThresholds, HashSet<u32>), PdfError> {
+    let extract = |restore_order| {
+        extract_pages_once(
+            doc,
+            font_cmaps,
+            page_filter,
+            include_invisible,
+            required_pages,
+            restore_order,
+        )
+    };
+
+    let (extraction, thresholds, gid_pages, evidence) = extract(false)?;

discussion_comments.comment_body:
Confirmed — a `page_filter` narrows what the verdict sees, so a selected page can fall below a floor the whole document would clear.

Not changing it, because the fix is to extract every page purely to judge a one-page request — a full extra document scan on the API's cheapest path. That seemed like the wrong trade to make unilaterally, so it's documented on `extract_positioned_text_impl` in 41da14e instead. Straightforward to flip if you'd rather have consistency than the latency; it's a one-line change to where evidence is gathered.

+    };

+        .ok()
+        .map(|i| table[i].1)
